title: build:candidate leaves the root package.json rewrite behind when packing throws before the restore
description: Found by the independent adversarial review of QCLI-419 (finding F5, 2026-09-29, inferred by line-by-line read, not executed). scripts/build-candidate-bundle.mjs rewrites the root package.json in place (questPlatformPackages digests, then a version swap per launcher pack) and restores it at two success-path points: after the rc launcher packs and after the final launcher packs. If the first `npm pack` or packLauncher throws (pack failure, tarballName mismatch), neither restore runs and the tree is left mutated -- version "X-rc.N" with re-derived digests -- which is exactly the hazard the file has a comment about: a red-case tampered digest once reached dev inside another change. Pre-existing, not a regression from QCLI-419, and outside that task scope. Fix direction: try/finally (or an explicit restore in each throw path) around the rewrite, proven with a fixture whose pack fails (e.g. a poisoned npm invocation seam) red before and green after.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A pack failure during bundle assembly leaves the working-tree package.json byte-identical to its pre-run state, proven by a red-then-green fixture that forces the failure.
